name: Enaliornis
sum: The oldest known hesperornithine, from the late Albian to early Cenomanian near Cambridge, England.
holotype: Isolated bones from near Cambridge, England (see Seeley 1876).
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Seeley 1876
